name: explorer/open-subfolder
description: Open File Explorer at a folder and double-click one of its subfolders to open it.
source_task: Open File Explorer at C:\Windows\Web and open the Wallpaper folder by double-clicking it (do not type a path). This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: Address bar is used only to reach the starting folder; the subfolder is still opened by double-click.
This step only passes if the window title has changed to the subfolder. The window stays open.
